'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Sokol DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
